messages.content: The lighthouse keeper climbed the spiral staircase every evening at dusk to light the great lamp and check the oil reserves, then he wrote the weather observations in the logbook with precise care, noting the wind direction, the sea state, and the visibility of the distant ships on the horizon. He trimmed the wick, polished the glass panels, and adjusted the rotation mechanism so the beam swept the same four sectors it had swept for generations, a steady rhythm that the fishing fleets relied on to round the headland safely even when the fog rolled in thick from the north.
